title: KR-Housing-LongRAG-Bench
description: A copyright-safe Korean long-context benchmark for evaluating long-context LLMs, RAG systems, and table/tool pipelines over real housing announcements, public tabular data, and housing statutes. The public release contains QA labels, evidence locators, deterministic predicates, answerability labels, split and provider/region metadata, and long-context-bundle references. It does not redistribute raw PDF/HWP/HWPX documents, bundle text, predictions, or API keys. v0.9.4 keeps the 1,997 QA, questions, splits, gold fixes and evaluation scope of v0.9.3 (1,876 evaluated items: dev 1,534 / test_public 342; legal family and 12 items excluded). Changes from v0.9.3: (1) Dense bge-m3 retrieval with 50 passages on the 81 aggregation items for six models (gpt-5.5, glm-5.2, minimax-m3, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5, gpt-4.1-mini), with the setting and the comparison rule against full context fixed before any generation call. Accuracy under the primary judge: 78%, 72%, 75%, 69%, 21%, 12% (full context 100%, 88%, 68%, 74%, 23%, 9%); a bootstrap over the 9 announcement-table pairs separates none of the differences from zero. The 50 passages hold the announcement page and every matched row for 63 items; no model answers any of the other 18 correctly. (2) minimax-m3: every reported run reasoned, including runs with the flag off; with the same flag the endpoint now returned no reasoning (23%); the reasoning-on run is reported, chosen after both runs were seen; both are released. (3) glm-5.2: 2 k=50 answers stayed empty after one retry (stopped at about 300 tokens) and are scored wrong. (4) Gold-page recall now assigns each passage to the page holding most of its characters: BM25 recall@5 dev 74.9%, pooled 78.7%, test 89.7% (unchanged). (5) The 122 dev items excluded from the bundle settings are those whose 512k bundle lacks at least one gold page. (6) Four minimax-m3 full-context aggregation answers were re-called once at the same cap when the run resumed on 2026-07-10, before the retry rule existed; without that call minimax-m3 scores 51 instead of 55 of 81. Scripts: scripts/v094/. The release is not leaderboard-ready and has no sealed hidden split.
